doc: Mapped client buffers on the non-coherent XUSB host use the request pool command per transfer, so prepare and complete reach its mapper. Controller DMA buffers retain their separate persistent mapping.

sites.why: AppleUSBHostBufferMemoryDescriptor::dmaCommandOperation: remember a command only without a mapper (cmp x8, #0), rather than when the mapping uses the buffer owner mapper (cmp x8, x9). SwitchXHCI always supplies its mapper, so request completion clears the command and unmaps before client reads.

AppleUSBHostControllerDMACommand::setMemoryDescriptor: its own bounce is read by synchronize(IN) before complete unmaps it. Pass getDirection() | kIOMapWriteCombineCache to its bounce allocator, preserving that copy order without a cached alias.
